strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag admissible-cell interior as novel restricted-support positivity and give a proof-facing justification that identifies exactly which fixing denominators it guarantees; alternatively cite a result formulated with structural zeros and selector support.
Define CI_y explicitly, including its componentwise plug-in variance, and state that the vector derivative uses a fixed Jacobian convention so IF_H and Sigma_H are unambiguous.

Sharpen the main field claim by proving that the fixed-support class is a strict, practically relevant regime not covered by the 2024 failure construction, with an explicit inclusion/non-inclusion comparison to its CS-SCM input model.

Turn the all-residual OEQ into a more discriminating fork: either exhibit a finite library invariant that guarantees a rational projection/global-box certificate, or identify a minimal residual family requiring an algebraic/nonrational functional and pivot the completeness headline accordingly.

recommended_next_step: Revise the positivity tag and define the omitted componentwise Wald interval, then retain the field-tier completeness OEQ as the genuine unresolved kernel.
